series_cumulative_points.label: NBA playoff series cumulative team points (total and spread)
series_cumulative_points.target: Combined points or cumulative point differential of two teams summed over all games of a playoff series vs a strike
series_cumulative_points.why_distinct: Sums per-game points over an endogenous number of games (series ends at 4 wins), so series length and per-game scoring jointly drive it; game_total/spread are single-game and series_and_cup ignores points.

out_of_scope_categories.audience_viewership: Television or streaming audience measures (Finals viewership thresholds) settled on published ratings figures, a media measure rather than NBA performance.
out_of_scope_categories.entertainment_exhibition: Exhibition entertainment events around the NBA whose participants are celebrities or non-NBA performers (Celebrity Game, Celebrity 3-Point Contest).
out_of_scope_categories.media_reporting_race: Which journalist or outlet first reports a transaction; settled by media reporting order, not by the transaction or NBA performance.
out_of_scope_categories.commercial_endorsements: Brand or sponsor partnership announcements with NBA players; decided by companies' commercial choices, not by NBA performance or league/team decisions.
